scope: Frozen single-NPU CustomVoice benchmark contract, all seven concurrency levels and all three repetitions; not a claim of global optimality or statistical significance
hardware: Ascend 910B1, physical NPU 0, one NPU per server, BF16
qualifications: SGLang uses the identical documented torch.xpu type-import compatibility patch on pinned main in every trial.
Both baseline configurations use the documented jemalloc workaround; the underlying upstream allocator issue was not fixed here.
First vLLM trial predates automatic environment/provenance recording; its physical NPU 0 placement is documented in the contemporaneous campaign report.
Shared-host, sequential trials: sample SD is descriptive, not a confidence interval.
Whisper WER/CER and WavLM speaker consistency are automatic quality measures, not a subjective naturalness study.
Results apply to the pinned workload, sampling settings, model and baseline configurations.
